as_told.title: Phone call from Captain White and indoctrination at first overseas PPD base
as_told.place_text: Overseas base in a warm climate

plain: An Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that in the early 1990s, at his first base after training, he got a call on the dorm phone from Captain White, his first contact officer. White gave him the name of his next contact and told him he would meet that person at a set time, and that the man "would have his arms folded". Sherman tells it twice, and in one version the base is overseas in a warm climate where he was also inducted into the work, which would mean a secret programme passed him quietly from handler to handler.
